name: rimkit
description: Completions, def name completion from the running game, go to definition, tests, release checks, deprecation warnings with quick fixes, Lua API stubs and auto-ship for RimKit mods.

commands.title: RimKit: Check or make preview and icon
RimKit: New mod from a template

rimkit.autoShipOnSave.description: Auto-run rimkit mod ship when saving Lua/meta.lua in a RimKit mod.

rimkit.executable.description: Path to rimkit.exe (or rimkit on PATH).

rimkit.modsDir.description: Optional Mods folder. Empty = rimkit default / RIMWORLD_MODS.

rimkit.defsFile.description: Def names exported by the dev tools (rimkit_defs.json). Empty looks in .rimkit/defs.json and the game's Config folder.
